req.title: Reject non-string title
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the title field is not a string.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-003 requires HTTP 422 when the title field is not a string. We test: (1) positive — valid string title yields 201 (EP, valid partition); (2) negative — integer title yields 422 (NEG); (3) negative — boolean title yields 422 (NEG); (4) negative — null/None title yields 422 (DT); (5) negative — float title yields 422 (NEG) — FIXED from EP to NEG because a negative test must not use EP heuristic; (6) negative — array title yields 422 (NEG); (7) boundary — numeric-string edge case yields 201 (BVA); (8) negative — missing title yields 422 (DT); (9) negative — object title yields 422 (NEG). The violation in test[4] (kind=negative, heuristic=EP) is corrected by changing heuristic to NEG.

tests.name: test_create_task_valid_string_title_returns_201
actions: POST /tasks/ with title as a valid non-empty string
expected: response body contains id, title, completed, created_at
trace: R-TASK-003 — positive partition: string title accepted
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

payload = {"title": "Buy groceries", "completed": False}
r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
assert r.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {r.status_code}: {r.text}"
body = r.json()
assert body["title"] == "Buy groceries"
assert body["completed"] == False
assert "id" in body
assert "created_at" in body
